title: 第7章 庶务殿第8章 千崖石阶
lines: 三人眼巴巴的看著被云凝霜称作吴师兄的中年男子，至於长袍青年和另一人则被他们略过了，他们不傻，看得出来中年人的地位更高。
“走吧，跟我来。”
中年人道了句，提步朝著前方而去。
三人紧隨其后，不过小胖周鹏却忍不住开口问道:“吴，吴师兄，我们去哪……”
中年人止步，还不等他开口，一旁的长袍青年却突然厉喝:“住嘴，吴师兄也是你们能叫的？到底是山野村夫，没有一点规矩。”
周鹏被嚇的浑身的肥肉一抖，脚底发软，王扶赶紧扶了小胖一把，不让他跌坐下去。
可长袍青年却不想轻易放过，紧接著一声冷哼响起，仿佛一道惊雷在三人耳边炸响，尤其是被他重点照顾的王扶，只觉得胸口一阵闷痛，差点上不来气。
王扶立马跌坐在地，王扶和周鹏也好不到哪去，三人滚在一堆，狼狈不堪。
“行了，他们刚入宗门还未修行，不知无过。”
好在中年人摆了摆手，他言语淡漠，“你们记住，修仙界实力为尊，咱们落羽宗同样如此，入宗不分先后，只重修为实力。”
“我名吴建央，你们应当称我一声师叔，这是我的弟子卫明，与你们同辈，至於赵泽霖和护送你们的云师妹乃是金丹长老的亲传弟子，各自相论便好。”
中年男子先后指了指身旁的两人。
“是，吴师叔。”
王扶三人心惊肉跳，再没了先前的轻鬆愜意。
片刻之后，来到一处殿宇內，庶务殿。
“你们依次將手放在测灵碑上。”
吴建央指著殿宇內一方丈高的巨大石碑，示意王扶三人上前去。
三人相视一眼，周鹏仍旧心有余悸，扯了扯王扶的衣角，王扶心中暗嘆，伸出手掌贴在了测灵碑上。
不消一两个呼吸，一道金色光芒缓缓在石碑上浮现，紧接著……绿色，蓝色，红色，黄色，五色光芒均匀的分布在石碑之上。
赵泽霖眼见那五色光芒，却是直接嗤笑出声，“我还以为是什么灵根，没想到竟是最垃圾的五行杂灵根。”
“也对，一个山野小村子，有灵根就不错了，不能奢望太高，反正就是走个流程。”
王扶望著石碑上的五种顏色，听著旁边的嗤笑，哪里不知道自己的资质並不好。
“赵师弟，梧桐村曾有恩於宗门的朱长老，你还是收敛一点。”
吴建央眉头微皱。
王扶心里暗恨，不敢表露。
忽然，一声大笑从殿宇外传来。
“哈哈哈……吴师兄，话不能这么说，我落羽宗在大夏国也是有头有脸的修仙宗门，收个五行杂灵根入门本就有失身份，难不成还不让说了？”
一个抱著圆滚滚的肚子，不足五尺身高的中年人款款走来，他锦衣华服加身，两撇八字鬍须冒著油光，开口间一颗大门牙金光闪闪。
此人走近摸了摸八字鬍须，笑笑咧咧的让出身来:“我去了一趟凡俗世界，找来了三个有灵根的小子，没想到这么巧碰见吴师兄也在给人测试灵根。”

他身后儼然是三个十来岁的少年。
“金师弟好运气，外出一趟就替宗门找来三个好苗子，恭喜。”
吴建央点头示意，隨后对王扶三人说道，“这是金相贵，你们金师叔。”
“金师叔……”
王扶三人见礼，心里已经给这个不足五尺的中年人安上了外號——大金牙。
“哪里哪里，”
content_en:
The three of them looked eagerly at the middle-aged man whom Yun Ningshuang called Senior Brother Wu. As for the young man in robes and the other man, they ignored them. They were not stupid, and they could see that the middle-aged man had a higher status.
"Come on, follow me."
The middle-aged man said something and walked forward.
The three of them followed closely, but chubby Zhou Peng couldn't help but ask: "Wu, Senior Brother Wu, where are we going..."
The middle-aged man stopped, but before he could speak, the young man in robes on the side suddenly shouted: "Shut up, are you allowed to call me Brother Wu? After all, he is a mountain villager and has no rules."
Zhou Peng was so frightened that the fat all over his body shook, and the soles of his feet became weak. Wang Fu quickly helped the little fat man to prevent him from falling down.
But the young man in the robe didn't want to let it go easily. Then a cold snort sounded, as if a thunder exploded in the ears of the three of them. Especially Wang Fu, who was being taken care of by him, felt a tight pain in his chest and almost couldn't breathe.
"Hmph!"
Wang Fu immediately fell to the ground. Wang Fu and Zhou Peng were not much better. The three of them rolled in a pile and were in a miserable state.
"Okay, they just joined the sect and haven't practiced yet, so they don't know anything wrong."
Fortunately, the middle-aged man waved his hand and said indifferently, "You remember, in the world of cultivating immortals, strength is respected, and the same is true for our Luo Yu Sect. There is no priority in joining the sect, only strength is based on cultivation."
"My name is Wu Jianyang. You should call me uncle. This is my disciple Wei Ming, who is of the same generation as you. As for Zhao Zelin and Junior Sister Yun who are escorting you, they are the direct disciples of Elder Jin Dan. It's okay to talk to each other."
The middle-aged man pointed to the two people next to him one after another.
"Yes, Master Wu."
Wang Fu and the others were frightened, and they no longer felt relaxed and comfortable as before.
After a while, they came to a palace, the General Affairs Hall.
"You all place your hands on the spiritual monument in turn."
Wu Jianyang pointed to the huge stone tablet one foot high in the palace and motioned to Wang to help the three of them step forward.
The three of them looked at each other. Zhou Peng was still frightened and tugged at the corner of Wang Fu's clothes. Wang Fu sighed inwardly and stretched out his palm to place it on the soul-detecting tablet.
In just one or two breaths, a golden ray of light slowly emerged on the stone tablet, and then... green, blue, red, yellow, five-color rays of light were evenly distributed on the stone tablet.
"Pfft..."
When Zhao Zelin saw the five-color light, he laughed out loud, "I thought it was some kind of spiritual root, but I didn't expect it to be the most rubbish five-element mixed spiritual root."
"That's right. It's a small village in the mountains. It's good to have spiritual roots. Don't expect too much. Anyway, it's just a process."
Wang Fu looked at the five colors on the stone tablet and listened to the sneers beside him. He didn't know that his qualifications were not good.
"Junior Brother Zhao, Elder Zhu who was kind to the sect in Wutong Village, you should restrain yourself."
Wu Jianyang frowned slightly.
Wang Fu felt secretly resentful and did not dare to express it.
Suddenly, a loud laugh came from outside the palace.
"Hahaha... Senior Brother Wu, you can't say that. Our Luo Yu Sect is also a reputable immortal cultivating sect in the Great Xia Kingdom. It would be disrespectful to accept a Five Elements Miscellaneous Spirit Root disciple. Is it possible that we won't let you talk about it?"
A middle-aged man with a round belly and less than five feet tall walked towards him. He was dressed in rich clothes, his mustache was shiny, and his big front teeth were shining with gold.
The man came closer, touched his mustache, and stepped aside with a smile: "I went to the mortal world and found three boys with spiritual roots. I didn't expect to meet Senior Brother Wu who was also testing spiritual roots."

Behind him seemed to be three teenagers.
"Junior Brother Jin is so lucky. He found three good young people for the sect during one trip. Congratulations."
Wu Jianyang nodded, and then said to Wang Fu and the others, "This is Jin Xianggui, your uncle Jin."
"Uncle Jin..."
